captions.detailed: A wall-mounted articulating arm lamp in a factory-style variant. It features a rectangular black backplate bracket, a black horizontal boom arm assembly with parallel bars, and a deep cylindrical lamp shade head finished in dark green with a light grey interior diffuser. The arm articulates horizontally from the wall bracket, and the lamp head tilts vertically on a swivel joint at the end of the arm.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a wall-mounted articulating factory-style arm lamp. The assembly should feature a rectangular wall bracket, a dual-bar horizontal arm, and a cylindrical lamp head that can rotate and tilt via integrated joints.
captions.factory: Construct the wall bracket using a flat rectangular box primitive. Build the articulating arm assembly using parallel rectangular extrusion bars connected via small cylindrical pivot pins. Create the lamp head by combining a larger hollowed-out cylinder for the dark green shade with a thin circular disc representing the light diffuser, then link all segments together using revolute joints for realistic articulation.
